subject: [RFC PATCH v3 5/8] mm/gup: fill the pages array outside the pud/pmd lock

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the huge page handling in the Linux kernel's memory management code to fill the pages array and flush caches outside of the pud/pmd lock. This is done by storing the page reference before unlocking, allowing the fill operation to occur safely without holding the lock. The changes are intended to be functional-equivalent to the original behavior, with no expected performance or correctness impact.
